records.issue_text: absolutize_urls treats protocol-relative URLs (//cdn.example.com/x) as root-relative paths and rewrites them to http://host/cdn.example.com/x, breaking links/images
records.rationale: In TopicEmbed.absolutize_urls, links/images are rewritten whenever href/src `start_with?('/')`. Protocol-relative URLs like `//cdn.example.com/x` also start with `/`, so they get rewritten to `"#{prefix}/#{href.sub(/^\/+/, '')}"`, producing `http://<host>/cdn.example.com/x` (or https), which breaks those URLs.
